channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Moritz Wagner | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Moritz Wagner from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jeff Weltman on Moritz Wagner
item.description:
“He’s further away. You guys know there’ve been unfortunately a series of ACLs in the last decade of the NBA and an associated timeline with that. But you guys also know Moe Wagner. So, he’s not your normal guy.“He’s attacking it. and we’re hopeful he can beat that timeline,”

Jeff Weltman on Moritz Wagner, Sep 29, 2025. Source: Orlando Sentinel.

item.title: Jamahl Mosley on Moritz Wagner
item.description:
Orlando Magic coach Jamahl Mosley on Moe Wagner:

“It broke me a little bit. I teared up as I watched Moe go down because you watched the work that he’s put in and you watched the tear he was on. He was in the running in my mind for Sixth Man of the Year.”

Jamahl Mosley on Moritz Wagner, Dec 23, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Al Horford on Moritz Wagner
item.description:
Horford on his ejection Friday for elbowing Mo Wagner:

“Just getting the ball inbounds, I felt like I was being kneed, kind of shoved, in an excessive fashion. I also thought his arm was trying to hit me, too. So I just kind of swung back with my arm, back at him.”

Al Horford on Moritz Wagner, Dec 18, 2022. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Tommy Sheppard on Moritz Wagner, Troy Brown
item.description:
Fred Katz:Wizards GM Tommy Sheppard:

“Unfortunately, when you acquire players, it means other players have to leave. I can’t say enough great things about Troy Brown and Moe Wagner.”

Tommy Sheppard on Moritz Wagner, Troy Brown, Mar 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Alex Len, Moritz Wagner
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Brooks on putting Len in the starting lineup in place of Wagner:

“Just needed a change... we gave up a lot of points in the paintand we needed a different look.”

Scott Brooks on Alex Len, Moritz Wagner, Mar 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Moritz Wagner
item.description:
Fred Katz:Scott Brooks on Moe Wagner’s afternoon:

“His energy and his mouth. Moe talks, Moe communicates…I like that. I like the fact that he’s always engaged. When he’s not playing, he’s always on the bench talking.”

Scott Brooks on Moritz Wagner, Feb 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Moritz Wagner
item.description:
Antetokounmpo added:

“I don't have nothing against Wagner, it wasn't just him. It was just like, in my mind, all these games I've played with guys hitting me, I lost it for a second.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Moritz Wagner, Aug 12, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Josh Hart, Kyle Kuzma, Moritz Wagner
item.description:
He not only caught the eye of president of basketball operations Magic Johnson and general manager Rob Pelinka, but Josh Hart and Kyle Kuzma as well.

“Kyle Kuzma and Josh Hart were actually at Moe Wagner’s workout, and both of them were elbowing Earvin and I, saying, ‘Man, this guy would be fun to play with. He plays with energy, he’s light on his feet,'”

Rob Pelinka on Josh Hart, Kyle Kuzma, Moritz Wagner, Jun 23, 2018. Source: Lakers Nation.
